rationale: Micah is building visual interfaces for machine learning at IntentiveAI, while Tushar has deep experience with data platforms and analytics infrastructure at Snowflake—together they span the full pipeline from data infrastructure to interpretable AI visualization. Tushar's expertise in SQL, cloud data optimization, and analytics workflows complements Micah's focus on making ML systems visually intuitive, and both are based in San Francisco and thinking about how to make data more actionable at scale.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Tushar Garg — you're both in San Francisco rethinking how data gets turned into human-readable insights, from cloud infrastructure down to visual interfaces.
